_comment: Copy this file to <work-dir>/config.json and fill the REQUIRED keys.
Work dir defaults to ~/github-portfolio-snapshot; override with GITHUB_SNAPSHOT_HOME.
This file must NOT be committed with real values — .gitignore already excludes config.json.
_required: github_login / base_token / registry_table have no defaults in code on purpose: this repository is public, and a shipped default would point a new operator at someone else's data.
_optional_structural: The following have generic defaults in snapshot.py. Override only if your Base differs.
_binaries: Leave empty to resolve from PATH. launchd's PATH is extremely narrow, so deploy/install.sh injects the directories of node/gh/lark-cli explicitly.
